title: What's Forex?
overview: Kurumi enters the world of forex to prove she can succeed where her mother once failed.

title: It's Okay, I've Got Leverage
overview: After some advice from her friend Mochiko, Kurumi takes a risky position trading the Australian dollar.

title: Do I Have to Cut My Losses…?
overview: AUD/JPY takes Kurumi on a wild ride, and she finds herself at risk of losing all the money she "borrowed."

title: Having No Unrealized Losses Is the Best
overview: Kurumi has an awkward confrontation with her dad, and then gets roped into teaching forex to a new investor.

title: Long? Short? Which Do I Choose?
overview: Kurumi quits forex and tries hard to find a new hobby, but the temptation to start trading again is strong.

title: Pay Attention to Economic Indicators!
overview: Mebuki attempts to trade forex without Kurumi's help, but does she know enough about how the markets work?

title: I Don't Wanna Have a Forced Liquidation...
overview: The girls begin an investment competition, all while Mebuki clings tenaciously to her risky short position.

title: Monetary Easing Is a Wild Party
overview: After losing all her initial funds, Mebuki resorts to borrowing money to maintain a short position on USD/JPY.
